desc: Establish the deletion-batch/inversion formulation and canonical ordering of same-valued occurrences within batches.
Exhaustively validate the compressed-run reduction model and rightmost-legal greedy policy against an exact BFS oracle on small instances; it is false.
Reject the four-run-reduction/rightmost-greedy approach due to counterexamples requiring neutral setup swaps.
Derive a correct polynomial DP over deletion groups/inversion costs that permits neutral setup swaps.
Implement the DP as a stdin-to-stdout contest solver with total complexity suitable for sum of N at most 2e5.
Exhaustively validate the finalized solver against the exact BFS oracle on small arrays, then test samples and edge patterns.
